exposure: Cord blood cytokines (Th1, Th2, growth factors, IL-8, MCP-1, MIP-1a)
cohort: The study included 135 patients admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at Sasebo City General Hospital.
finding: Inflammatory chemokines (IL-8, MCP-1, MIP-1a) and biomarkers (N-Terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide, nucleated RBC, urinary b2-microglobulin) in cord blood were significantly associated with intrauterine inflammation, premature birth, and neonatal complications such as PDA, RDS, and CLD.
